caseName: Strine v. Del. Coal. for Open Gov't, Inc.
caseNameFull: Leo E. STRINE, Jr. v. DELAWARE COALITION FOR OPEN GOVERNMENT, INC.

opinions.text: Motion of TechNet for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Law Firms for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.
